transcript: Meta see something called Entity ID. Essentially a fingerprint is assigned to your creative based on what it actually looks like visually, not what you've named it or how many times you have uploaded it into the ad account. If two ads look similar to the algorithm, so say they have same lighting, same model, same aesthetic treatment, same format, they get assigned the same entity ID. Essentially, they get assigned the same fingerprint. And then this is what happens. They share the same performance history, they share the same delivery expectations, they compete literally for the same audience pool. And any new version that you upload gets no refresh learning opportunity because it's actually pre judged based on everything it had learnt from the other ads that look similarly.
